verdict.rationale: SoloKeys Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/passkey security key, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence covers firmware updates, custom firmware builds, and CLI device admin commands, but none of these is an automation system the user authors and manages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
